summary: End-to-end validation of the new PHARMACY admin configuration (iter115). Backend: 14/14 pytest passing — GET/PUT /api/admin/pharmacy/settings (admin auth gated, persisted), free_threshold + min connectivity reflected in /api/pharmacy/orders/estimate (subtotal<10 → fee=3, subtotal>=10 → fee=0), active=false blocks POST /api/pharmacy/orders with 400 'Le service Pharmacie est momentanément indisponible', active=true restores order creation, categories CRUD with unique-key 400 / not-found 404 / 400 when products use the category, and public GET /api/pharmacy/categories reflects DB. Frontend admin (/admin/pharmacy): 'Paramètres' tab toggles active, edits info_note + 4 delivery fields, save shows 'Enregistré' toast and values persist after reload. 'Catégories' tab CRUD (add/edit/delete) works, new category appears in both Products filter (product-cat-filter) and the product editor dropdown (prod-cat) — fully DYNAMIC, no hard-coded categories anymore. Client /pharmacy info banner displays the admin-configured note (verified visually 'TEST_INFO_BANNER_iter115'). Regression iter114: 16/16 pytest still passing.
action_items: Optional UX: in PharmacyPage, after backend toggles active=false the client banner currently relies on /api/pharmacy/settings being re-fetched on mount — consider a short polling or websocket to make the inactive state visible immediately to clients already on the page (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pharmacy.py SettingsModel + admin_update_settings correctly upsert with id='default' and the same get_settings() is reused by public + private endpoints — clean.
DeliveryConfig uses Pydantic Field(ge=0) on all numeric fields → negative values are 422 rejected (good).
_delivery_fee applies free_threshold BEFORE pharmacy distance calc — correct precedence.
Category delete guard (count_documents on pharmacy_products) prevents orphaning products — good.

AdminPharmacy.js useCategories hook reuses the PUBLIC /pharmacy/categories endpoint (no auth) which is fine because the endpoint already returns DB list; this means both admin and client share the same source of truth.

SettingsTab UI: minor — when typing in numeric inputs, value is stored as a string; save() coerces with Number() — OK but a stray non-numeric input becomes 0 silently. Consider adding inline validation or min='0'.
PharmacyPage.js handles active=false correctly (disables both action buttons + red banner) but only re-reads settings on page mount — see action item above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on settings persistence, categories CRUD dynamism, info banner; inactive banner UI render not visually re-verified in playwright (race) but backend behaviour confirmed
